title: eval-harness: integrate prompt-regression gating with CI and export eval metrics to observability
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: prevent prompt-set regressions from reaching main and give SRE/product early visibility into evaluation metric deltas. This PR wires the eval-harness prompt-regression job into our CI pipeline, adds a metrics exporter to push eval results to the observability backend, and implements a configurable quality gate so PRs fail when key eval metrics regress beyond thresholds. Changes: - add .github/workflows/eval-regression-ci.yml job that runs prompt-regression on PRs and scheduled nightly runs, uploads artifacts and posts a summary comment - add eval-harness/run_regression.py orchestration script to run prompt sets, compute metrics, and emit both JSON artifact and observability events - add eval-harness/metrics/exporter.py which sends aggregated metrics (accuracy, pass-rate, hallucination-rate, mean-latency) to the internal observability endpoint with tags for repo/branch/commit - add ci/scripts/collect_eval_artifacts.sh for CI artifact collection and upload - docs/eval/ci-gating.md with rollout instructions and threshold config - tests: test/eval/test_regression_integration.py + small unit test updates Checklist: - [x] CI job definition and secrets validated - [x] Metrics exporter implements retry/backoff and idempotency - [x] Quality gate is configurable via eval_config.yaml and feature flag rollout - [x] Unit and integration tests added - [x] Observability dashboards updated (link: https://console.internal.redwood/observability/dashboards/eval-harness) Rollout plan: start gated on small set of repos for two weeks, then enable across monorepo. If gate triggers unexpectedly, the automation will post a PR comment with metric deltas and link to the detailed artifact. Related: ENG-1423 (quality gates), ENG-1548 (observability integration).
